page.layout: One page, title page, all lines centred in one block: small "IN" at the top, then a large title in capitals, a short block of lines, a large printer's name, and small printer's lines and date at the foot.
page.notes: The scan is faint and mirrored in places: the large title lines show show-through from the reverse, so letters are doubtful. The title words "ORADIAM" and "PROPHETAM" are unverified readings and should be checked against the original. The lower printer's lines and the date are too faint to read reliably. The Greek word and the "Vtrum" / "Vtriusque" lines are doubtful. The printer's name and date may be Basel, 16th century, but the scan does not show this clearly enough to confirm it. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed.
